scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace=@point-nemo/shared && concurrently -k -n api,web "tsx watch apps/api/src/server.ts --dev" "npm run dev --workspace=@point-nemo/web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@point-nemo/shared && npm run build --workspace=@point-nemo/api && npm run build --workspace=@point-nemo/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace=@point-nemo/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.release:check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:smoke && npm run build
scripts.test: npm run test:assets && npm run test:api && npm run test:web
